correctness.rationale: From T_n=T_0+n(a+b), the exact imbalance recursion is x_n=(1−2bξ_n/T_n)x_(n−1)+(a+b−2bξ_n)(η_n−x_(n−1))/T_n. Its last term is a bounded square-summable-variance martingale difference. Divergent sum ξ_n/n kills the product of contractions and weighted noise by summation by parts; finite weight leaves an absolutely summable drift and convergent martingale. At a late Pólya step, positive conditional draw variance propagates through a strictly positive remaining damping product, forcing Var(x∞|ξ)>0. For independent ξ_n, ∑(ξ_n−p_n)/n converges a.s. Exact finite rational examples from the inspected checker are consistent; infinite convergence rests on proof, not code.
